stem.text: The circuit shown includes a cell of constant internal resistance and an external resistor R.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a dashed box labelled cell containing a cell symbol and a resistor symbol in series, an external resistor labelled R with a voltmeter V connected across it, and an ammeter A in the outer loop.

stem.text: A student records the ammeter and voltmeter readings. She then connects a second identical external resistor in parallel with the first external resistor.
What happens to the ammeter reading and to the voltmeter reading?
